name: Brief Heartbeat Counting
source: EMA Forge demonstration preset; heartbeat-counting scores have known interpretive limitations.
intended_use: Concise feasibility configuration of the built-in heartbeat-counting task.
estimated_burden: Approximately 3–5 minutes, depending on practice and signal-quality retries.
validation_status: Research demonstration; scoring should not be treated as a pure measure of interoceptive accuracy.
device_requirements: HTTPS plus a compatible rear camera and controllable torch for objective pulse comparison.
